accommodation.title: Websites for accommodation
accommodation.description: Tailor-made sites for apartments, villas, and holiday homes. Mediterranean design, fast galleries, and a clear path to booking — built for guests who decide in seconds.

taxi.title: Business websites
taxi.description: Professional online presence for small and medium businesses, tradespeople and service providers. A clear overview of what you do, your team and contact — everything that builds trust and turns visitors into clients.

software.title: Custom software
software.description: Business platforms and internal systems — from a web portal for energy grid balancing to a public-transport timetable management system.

mobile.title: Mobile apps
mobile.description: Android apps for demanding domains — from speech therapy for children to computer vision for solving geometry problems.

patrickboy.title: Taxi Transfer Website
patrickboy.description: Website for a private taxi and transfer company. Showcases services and destinations with a clear call to book a ride.

apartmani.title: Seaside Apartments Website — Cres
apartmani.description: Website for sea-view apartments on the island of Cres. Mediterranean-toned design featuring apartment layouts, an interactive gallery, and integrated Google Maps location.

vilaistra.title: Luxury Villa Website — Istria
vilaistra.description: Website for a luxury villa in the heart of Istria. Cinematic hero video, interior showcase, surrounding attractions, and integrated direct booking. Site is still under development.

houselucy.title: Holiday House Website
houselucy.description: Website for a holiday house in Ražanac featuring a drone photo showcasing the house and nearby bay. Design inspired by the Dalmatian ambience with an interior and surroundings gallery.

otooles.title: Guest House Website — Plitvice Lakes
otooles.description: Website for a family-run guest house near Plitvice Lakes National Park. Showcases accommodation and surrounding nature with details on rooms, homemade cuisine, and proximity to the park.

flexportal.title: Energy Grid Balancing Platform & Web Portal
flexportal.description: Worked on a web portal built using TypeScript and React.js. Features include user and customer management, white-labeling, resource activation tracking, settings, and reporting.

timetable.title: Timetable Management System for Public Transport
timetable.description: Cloud-based system for importing and managing public transport timetables using VDV 452 and NeTEx standards. Includes routing, detours, announcements, and traffic light control.

angler.title: Angler — Geometry Scanner App
angler.description: Android app using computer vision to solve geometry problems via smartphone scanning. Winner of App Start Contest, Croatia's largest student startup competition.

bonfon.title: Bonfon — Speech Therapy App for Children
bonfon.description: Android application for monitoring and assisting child speech and language therapy. Designed primarily for tablets, it helps correct articulation disorders through various exercises. Rector's Award winner.

thesis.title: Distributed Mechanism for Sensor Networks
thesis.description: Project analyzing different aspects of distributed processing of complex requests in sensor networks. Proposed mechanism inspired by fog computing and auction algorithms.

smarthome.title: Smart Home Apps
smarthome.description: IoT environments with accompanying Android apps for smart home device control and real-time sensor monitoring with intuitive data visualization.

labels.ctaDescription: Get in touch and let's figure out how to make it happen.

patrickboy.challenge: A private transfer company needed an online presence that instantly builds trust and makes booking a ride effortless — no complex forms or extra steps.
patrickboy.solution: We built a fast static site in Astro with a clear overview of services and popular destinations, focused on a direct call to action and instant contact, so a guest reaches a booking in a couple of clicks.
patrickboy.outcome: A lightweight site that loads almost instantly, ranks well on Google and turns visitors into ride enquiries.

vilaistra.challenge: A luxury villa in Istria needed a site that conveys an exclusive experience and drives direct bookings, without intermediaries or commissions.
vilaistra.solution: We're building a cinematic site with a hero video, interior showcase and nearby attractions, plus an integrated direct booking system.
vilaistra.outcome: The site is in its final stage — the goal is a premium feel that justifies a higher nightly rate and reduces reliance on platforms.

apartmani.challenge: Seaview apartments needed a site that convinces a guest within seconds and guides them toward a booking enquiry.
apartmani.solution: A Mediterranean-toned design with an interactive gallery, a view of each apartment and integrated Google Maps, all optimised for mobile.
apartmani.outcome: A fast, clear site that makes the decision easy for guests and brings the owner direct, commission-free bookings.

houselucy.challenge: A holiday house in Ražanac needed a presentation that captures the Dalmatian atmosphere and its closeness to the sea.
houselucy.solution: We used drone photography of the house and the nearby cove and built the site in Astro with a gallery of the interior and surroundings.
houselucy.outcome: A visually rich, fast site that sells the holiday experience before the guest even sends an enquiry.

otooles.challenge: A family guesthouse near Plitvice needed a site highlighting its proximity to the national park and its homemade offering.
otooles.solution: We created a clear overview of the rooms, home cooking and surrounding nature, with all the info guests planning a park visit need.
otooles.outcome: A site that answers every guest question in one place and encourages direct contact with the guesthouse.

flexportal.challenge: Sympower needed a web portal for balancing the energy grid — a complex system with multiple user types, clients and resources.
flexportal.solution: We developed a platform in TypeScript and React.js with user and client management, white-labeling, resource monitoring, settings and reporting; backend in Kotlin on AWS.
flexportal.outcome: A scalable portal that gives operators real-time control over energy grid resources.

timetable.challenge: Atron needed a system to import and manage public transport timetables to the VDV 452 and NeTEx standards.
timetable.solution: We built a microservice architecture (Java, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes) for planning routes, diversions and announcements, with advanced traffic-light control at intersections.
timetable.outcome: A reliable system that processes large volumes of transport data and supports demanding operational scenarios.

angler.challenge: Solving geometry problems by hand is slow and error-prone — it needed to be sped up with a smartphone scan.
angler.solution: We developed an Android app that uses computer vision (OpenCV) to recognise a geometry problem from an image and compute the solution.
angler.outcome: The app won the App Start Contest and showed how computer vision can solve an everyday educational problem.

bonfon.challenge: Children's speech therapy lacked a digital tool for tracking and practising articulation, tailored for tablets.
bonfon.solution: We built an Android app with a range of exercises for correcting articulation disorders and tracking a child's progress.
bonfon.outcome: The paper on the app's development received the Rector's Award, and the tool helps therapists and parents in their work with children.

thesis.challenge: Processing complex queries in sensor networks is distributed and resource-constrained — it needed an efficient allocation mechanism.
thesis.solution: We proposed a mechanism inspired by fog computing and auction algorithms for distributed query processing.
thesis.outcome: The analysis shows how smart task allocation reduces load and latency in sensor networks.

smarthome.challenge: Smart home devices needed a simple, visual interface for control and real-time sensor monitoring.
smarthome.solution: We set up IoT environments with Android apps for controlling devices and intuitively visualising sensor data.
smarthome.outcome: Users gain control over their home and insight into sensor data through a simple, clear app.
